localai.barWarmingHint: The completion model is loading. Suggestions start once it is ready.
localai.title: AI autocomplete
dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.hint: Speak into the AI fields and the text writes itself. Whisper runs on this computer — the audio is not kept and does not leave it.
dictation.micBlocked: CodeFlow has no access to the microphone. Give it access in the system's privacy settings, then dictate again.
dictation.micDenied: CodeFlow has no access to the microphone.
dictation.micUndetermined: The system asks for the microphone the first time you dictate.
dictation.limit: Five minutes is the longest recording: it was written as it stood.
dictation.unsupported: Dictation is not available on this platform.
dictation.model.large: Most accurate · translates to English · heavy
dictation.model.parakeet: Fastest · 25 European languages · runs on the CPU
dictation.model.canary: Translates between Spanish, English, German and French
voice.sherpaNote: Parakeet and Canary run on the sherpa-onnx library ({size}), downloaded with the first of them and shared with Meetings and the voices.
voiceFit.class.apple: Apple Silicon: Whisper runs on the GPU; Parakeet, Canary and the voices on the CPU.
voiceFit.class.pc: A PC: listening and the voices run on the CPU (a graphics card speeds up the local AI models, not these).
voiceFit.class.modest: A modest machine: the light models are recommended, so Codi and dictation answer without a wait.
voiceFit.estimatedHint: Estimated for this kind of machine — measured here once it is downloaded.
dictation.engineFirst: The first install also downloads the engine (whisper.cpp, {size}).
dictation.shortcut: {chord} with the cursor in an AI field starts it; again, writes the text.
localai.hint: Ghost-text completions from a model running on this machine — in the code editor, in schema diagrams and in the database console. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.
localai.enableHint: Suggests the rest of a line or block as you type, in every editor in the app. Press Tab to accept.
localai.selectedNotInstalled: {model} is selected but not downloaded. Download it, or press Use on one you already have.
localai.needsModel: Autocomplete is on, but no model is downloaded yet. Pick one below — the recommended one is about 1.5 GB.
localai.engineMissing: This copy of CodeFlow is missing its completion engine, so autocomplete can't run. Reinstalling restores it.
localai.unknownModel: The selected model ({id}) isn't in this version's catalogue. Pick one below.
localai.deleteConfirm: Delete {model}? This frees {size} and you'd have to download it again to use it.
localai.note: Completions come from a small model, so they're good at finishing the line you're on and at what the surrounding text already implies — not at reasoning across files. The first suggestion after a pause takes a moment while the model loads; it's released again after five minutes of not typing.
localexec.title: Local model
localexec.hint: Writes the code in hybrid tasks while your subscription plans and reviews. It runs on this machine; how much fits depends on the model and the memory here.
localexec.backendBundledHint: CodeFlow's own engine. Download a model below; nothing else to install.
localexec.backendOpenaiHint: LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, LocalAI or a LiteLLM proxy.
localexec.remote: This URL is another machine: the code each task carries is sent to {host}.
localexec.roomUnified: of ~{gpu} macOS gives the GPU ({ram} RAM)
localexec.fitTight: Just fits — other apps can slow it down.
localexec.fitSpills: Doesn't fit in GPU memory: part of it runs on the CPU, much slower. Lower the context or pick a smaller model.
localexec.fitNo: Doesn't fit in this machine's memory.
localexec.fitUnknown: Its memory can't be estimated — Try shows what it really uses.
localexec.errMalformed: The server answered in an unexpected format.
localexec.errEngineMissing: This install is missing its local model engine. Reinstalling restores it.
localexec.errNoModels: The server answers but lists no models.
localexec.notReady: The local model isn't ready. Check Settings › AI engines › Local model.
localexec.perTaskHint: Every task is a fresh request with only its instruction, the code it changes and the references that fit. Nothing piles up between tasks.
localexec.perTaskValue: up to {input} tokens · {output} for the answer
localexec.probeNone: Not measured on this machine yet
localexec.probeTruncated: The server cut the prompt ({kept} of ~{sent} tokens). Raise its context or lower this one.
localexec.delegateHint: The planner rates each task; what this leaves out goes to your subscription in the review.
localexec.noServer: No local server is answering. Use Built-in, or open Ollama or LM Studio.
localexec.estimateRam: From this machine's RAM read speed: ~{ram}, measured here. A model writes at about the pace of the memory it lives in. Try measures the real speed.
localexec.estimateCard: From the memory it would live in: the {gpu}'s VRAM and, for whatever doesn't fit, RAM at ~{ram}, measured here. Try measures the real speed.
localexec.estimateCardOnly: From the memory it would live in: the {gpu}'s VRAM. Try measures the real speed.
localexec.estimateUnified: From the read speed of the {gpu}'s unified memory: ~{speed}. Try measures the real speed.
common.openProjectHint: Open a local repository from the + button in the sidebar to get started.
common.notARepoTitle: {name} is not a git repository any more
common.notARepoBody: The folder is still there and your files are untouched, but its .git is gone — so there is nothing here to show a history, a diff or a branch for. Create a repository in it, or remove it from the list.
common.initRepoConfirm: Create a new git repository in {path}? Your files are left exactly as they are — nothing is added, staged or committed.
common.initRepoDone: {name} is a git repository again. Everything in the folder is untracked until you make the first commit.
task.meetingsHint: Minutes, decisions, tasks and answers written from a meeting's transcript. Text only — follows the notes row until you set it. Meetings in books marked local-only always use the local model.
meetings.title: Meeting
meetings.busyElsewhere: Another note is recording a meeting
meetings.kind.virtualHint: Microphone and this computer's audio (Teams, Meet, Zoom) — you and the others apart
meetings.kind.roomHint: Microphone only — every voice in the room is separated
meetings.mode.label: Mode
meetings.mode.lightHint: Only records while the meeting runs; text and speakers when it ends. For modest computers and long meetings.
meetings.mode.balancedHint: Text appears as people speak; the speakers are separated when it ends.
meetings.mode.fullHint: Text and provisional speakers live, then everything again with the largest model when it ends.
meetings.needEngine: Download a model that listens first — Whisper or Parakeet — in Settings › Voice & sound › Models.
meetings.consentHint: Let the participants know you are recording.
meetings.consentMessage: I'm going to record this meeting to take notes. Is that all right with everyone?
meetings.liveBehind: Live text paused — this computer is busy; it will finish at the end
meetings.recordOnly: Recording only; text when it ends
meetings.mic.meterHint: How the transcription hears you: green is right, yellow is at the limit, red is too loud (it distorts) or too low (it gets lost in the noise). The line marks the loudest peak of the last two seconds.
meetings.mic.gainHint: Raises or lowers what the microphone captures — the recording and the transcription hear it. Double-click to go back to 100%.
meetings.system.meterHint: How the transcription hears the call's other side (what this computer plays): green is right, yellow at the limit, red too loud or too low. To change it, change the call app's volume.
meetings.mic.muteHint: Mute the microphone in CodeFlow only: the meeting records silence on it, and other apps keep hearing you
meetings.discardConfirm: Discard this recording? The audio and anything transcribed so far are deleted.
meetings.editHint: Double-click a line to correct it
meetings.localOnlyHint: This note's book is local-only: transcription and AI stay on this computer.
meetings.peopleOtherPrompt: How many people were in the meeting?
meetings.deleteConfirm: Delete this meeting? Its audio, transcript and speakers go; the note stays.
meetings.voiceSaved: Voice «{name}» saved — it will be recognised in the next meetings
meetings.failedToast: A meeting could not be finished: {error}
meetings.micDenied: The system is not letting CodeFlow use the microphone.
meetings.systemDenied: This computer's audio could not be recorded, so only the microphone is. On macOS, allow CodeFlow under Privacy › System Audio Recording.
meetings.noModel: Meetings need a model that listens: Whisper or Parakeet. Download one in Settings › Voice & sound › Models, or choose cloud transcription.
meetings.noCloudKey: Cloud transcription needs the service's key. Add it in Settings › Voice & sound › Meetings, or transcribe on this computer.
meetings.ai.localUnavailable: No local model is ready. This book is local-only — set one up in Settings › AI engines › Local model.
meetings.ai.askPlaceholder: Ask about the meeting — what was decided about the budget?
meetings.ai.instructionPlaceholder: Or say what to write — a table of who owns what…
meetings.suggest.title: A call started
meetings.suggest.body: {app} is using the microphone. Take notes of this meeting?
meetings.settings.title: Meetings
voice.hint: Downloaded once and kept on this computer. Each one says what uses it.
voice.deleteUsed: Remove {model} ({size})? {users} use it; they will need another model.
meetings.settings.vocabularyHint: Names and terms Whisper should spell right — people, products, acronyms. Whisper reads them before each piece of audio (Parakeet takes no vocabulary). Separate them with commas.
meetings.settings.threadsHint: How many processor cores Whisper may use. Fewer keeps the call smooth on a modest laptop; more transcribes faster. Automatic uses half. Parakeet always uses two to four.
meetings.settings.hint: Record a meeting into a note: text with who said what, and the AI that writes it up. Whisper or Parakeet runs on this computer unless you choose the cloud.
meetings.settings.searchTerms: meetings record transcription whisper parakeet speakers diarization voices teams zoom minutes cloud
meetings.settings.unsupported: Meetings are not available on this platform.
meetings.settings.transcriptionHint: Books marked local-only always transcribe here.
meetings.settings.noModels: No model that listens is downloaded (Whisper or Parakeet).
meetings.settings.moreModels: Models are downloaded in Voice and shared with Dictation.
meetings.settings.vocabularyPlaceholder: Names and terms to spell right: CQRS, María Pérez, CodeFlow
meetings.settings.cloudHint: The audio is sent in pieces to this service. A server of your own (faster-whisper behind an OpenAI-style API) works too.
meetings.settings.modeHint: How much is done while the meeting runs. Automatic picks from a measurement of this computer.
meetings.settings.voicesHint: Separates the voices into Person 1, Person 2… and recognises the ones you saved. Runs on this computer.
meetings.settings.voicesUnsupported: Speaker separation is not available on this platform.
meetings.settings.voicesRemoveConfirm: Delete speaker separation? Saved voices stay.
meetings.settings.noVoices: No voices saved yet — name a speaker in a meeting and choose «Remember voice».
meetings.settings.forgetVoice: Forget the voice «{name}»? Meetings keep the names already written.
meetings.settings.audioHint: Backups carry the text; the audio stays on this computer. Export it from a meeting to keep it elsewhere.
meetings.settings.detect: Suggest taking notes when Teams, Zoom or a browser call uses the microphone
voice.sectionHint: What CodeFlow listens with and speaks through: the microphone, the speaker, the models, dictation, meetings and the voice that reads aloud.
voice.devicesHint: Where CodeFlow listens and where it sounds.
voice.micHint: Dictation and meetings listen through it.
localexec.toolsHint: Whether this model calls tools correctly, measured against its exact weights. A model that fails is not used to edit files.
localexec.reasoningHint: When a model that can reason may think first. It helps hard questions and takes much longer.
localexec.needsCudaHint: Its weights use a format llama.cpp runs only on CUDA: it runs with Ollama on an NVIDIA card.
localexec.errNeedsCuda: {model} only runs on an NVIDIA card through Ollama.
localexec.errCloudModel: That model runs in Ollama's cloud. CodeFlow only uses models on this machine.
localexec.errNotLocal: {url} is not on this machine or your local network. CodeFlow only uses local models.
localexec.pressureWarning: The system is short of memory right now: a model loaded now will slow everything down. Close apps or lower the context.
localexec.pressureCritical: The system is almost out of memory: loading a model now will make it swap hard. Close apps first.
meetings.deleteAudioConfirm: Delete this meeting's audio? The transcript, speakers and note stay; the audio cannot be recovered, and re-transcribing needs it.
meetings.settings.afterStopHint: Transcribing later keeps the recording, compressed, until you press «Transcribe» on the meeting; its audio does not expire before then. Each recording's menu can also do the other one.
